name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It meets WCAG AAA for low vision, ensuring users with severe visual impairments can reliably track focus. The trade-off is slightly larger touch targets on mobile, but the improved visibility outweighs the minor space cost.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring at 7:1 still fails AAA for users with tunnel vision or cognitive load who need *zero* visual noise. A 2px ring at 8:1 with a 1px outer glow meets AAA and keeps focus visible without clutter. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion time for screen-reader users navigating dense forms.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 2px focus ring at 8:1 contrast with a 1px outer glow. It meets WCAG AAA for users with tunnel vision or cognitive load while keeping focus visible without clutter. The trade-off is slightly reduced visibility for users with severe low vision who rely on thicker rings, but the glow compensates and improves usability for the broader audience.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks disappearing on high-DPI screens where pixels blur, and the glow adds motion that violates reduced-motion preferences. Test a 3px ring at 7.5:1 with a static 0.5px inner shadow instead—it splits the difference without motion. Settle it with user testing: measure focus detection time for both groups and pick the faster one.
